source_basis: Root own complete current catalog production1-164 and MotionId owner1-134 plus previously read builtin/typed runtime recipients

lenses.source_disposition: Both pose/reference errors retain supplied MotionId via clone; builtin construction passes CatalogError to final diagnostics.
Consumes existing canonical MotionId from catalog_id, no new identity type.
Valid-but-absent motion payload differs from invalid raw motion stem/directory rejection. No new unchecked constructor or decoder introduced.
Clone retains the existing identity representation; no arithmetic or mutating identity operation introduced.
Existing error enum still owns each rejection payload; no independent optional fields or incoherent state added.
Identity remains owned by canonical catalog_id module; error imports that type directly.
No duplicate key, map, cache, stored text projection or synchronization authority introduced.
Membership checks, success paths, error selection and builtin diagnostic receiver are unchanged. Missing-motion error payload intentionally becomes typed; no compatibility path is retained.
Uses existing Clone/Debug/PartialEq/Eq derives. No handwritten trait boilerplate or source/downcast shim added.
UnknownMotion owns checked MotionId; invalid input variants own unadmitted text. Existing enum alternatives retain their distinct meanings.
Motion identity and generic invalid-input text have different contracts; one checked owner is reused for both pack-membership failures.
Removes the two internal MotionId.to_string projections. Human formatting remains at catalog construction diagnostics; actual invalid input remains available at its decode boundary.
No new numeric leaf, value, index, quantity, scale, probability or native format is introduced or changed.
